title: Analysis of CVEs
description:
This space provides structured access to comprehensive CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) v5 data, supporting analysis of security vulnerabilities, affected products, and severity metrics.  

**Capabilities:**
- Analyze vulnerability trends over time using CVE IDs, years, states, and publication/update dates.
- Assess vulnerability severity and impact through CVSS scores, severities, CWE classifications, and exploitation indicators.
- Identify affected vendors, products, and versions to target risk management and remediation efforts.
- Track reference sources and supporting documentation for vulnerabilities.

**Limitations:**
- Does not include real-time exploit or threat data beyond reported CVEs.
- Lacks detailed remediation status or patch information for vulnerabilities.
- Business impact and asset inventory are not captured within this dataset.
